data.narrative:
Glyphic Biotechnologies is a Series A biotech company founded by Joshua Yang and Daniel Estandian that has raised $44M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a broader Biotech & Health sector universe comprising 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

The stage-progression method is the primary applicable valuation approach. Using total capital raised ($44M) as a proxy for current valuation and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A progression to the next financing stage yields $88M. This method is appropriate given the company's stage and capital history. The peer-median approach could not be applied due to insufficient narrow-stage comparables in the Biotech & Health sector—while 7 same-sector peers exist, none met the adjacent-stage or similar-tier filters necessary for reliable calibration. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (7.4x median across the 3 public tickers) is structurally unavailable; target revenue has not been disclosed.

Based on this single-method triangulation, the analysis supports a valuation range of $75M to $101M, with $88M as the median estimate. Key uncertainties include the company's actual revenue run rate (which would enable public-comp validation), the specific capital deployment rate and clinical progress since the prior round, and relative positioning versus the identified private peer set. Widening the applicable methodologies would require additional operational or financial disclosures.
